main_text.p: ta, inquit, jam crucis candida-tus : bene, & pro hoc sensu. Etsi autem Crux proprie in li-gno : tamen adnoto, similitu-dine etiam ita dictam suspen-sionem aut fixionem in alia pa-ratura. puta in monte aut pe-Cruces in pe-tra.tra. Sic Tertulliano fuint Cru-ces Caucasorum, alludenti ad Promethea illic affixum : quem ipsum Lucianus describit & ap-pellat τραγοσκιλα. Sic & Ma-nilius de Andromeda, quae in scopulo vincta & ceto expo-sita :

p.i: Et cruce virginea moritura puel-la pependit.

main_text.p: 1 Lib. 1. adver. Marc. c. 1. 2 Lib. v.

page.notes: Marginal note "Cruces in petra" printed at left beside the lines "tra. Sic Tertulliano"; Greek word in the text ("τραγοσκιλα") is an uncertain reading. Page-top running head is printed as "6 DE CRVCE" with page number 6. Catchword absent. Faint show-through and stains at the page edges were omitted.
